svg.title: Test 6 mechanics — f-string interpolation builds four search literals across the loop
svg.desc: Four-iteration loop visualization showing how the f-string template at the top of the diagram interpolates each ticker symbol from the sector_equity_tickers tuple to produce a unique search literal, then each literal is checked as a substring of NB04 source code and reports as found with a green checkmark for all four tickers including XLF XLK XLE and XLV which collectively confirm the four required entries exist in the ASSET_CLASS_MAP dictionary.
svg.text: Test 6 mechanics — f-string interpolation, four substring checks
f-string template (resolved at runtime each iteration):
↑ XLV — the regression case. This row is the entire reason Test 6 exists.
Same mechanical pattern as Test 2 — substring search via `in source` — but with f-string interpolation
like Test 3. Each iteration builds a fresh literal at runtime, then asserts that literal appears in NB04.
All four iterations pass → test green → all four sector-ETF mappings are intact.
Loop iteration order matches tuple order: XLF, XLK, XLE, XLV — first-failure-wins if any assertion breaks.
A failure prints the exact literal that was not found, making the missing entry immediately diagnosable.
